items.title: Pete Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: I went over with Benny Carter, with different players, you know Frank Wess and really some wonderful players.

ctx.x: What has your experience been overseas?

Fine. The reception of course, they know more about an artist over there then they do here in the States. It’s like one time I went over with Benny Carter, with different players, you know Frank Wess and really some wonderful players. And had about maybe ten, twelve concerts, and we landed at Narita airport, and there’s white sheets from a bed, king size probably, all strung together “Welcome Pete Candoli and Blackwell and Benny Carter, all the guy’s names and we got all the people applauding, fans, they know who…
